<fragment>
  <trace source="genie-obo" severity="information">
    <message>@{
      var jwt = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<Jwt>("genie-user-jwt");
      return new JObject(
        new JProperty("event", "genie_request"),
        new JProperty("source", "apim"),
        new JProperty("correlationId", context.RequestId.ToString()),
        new JProperty("stage", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("audit-stage", "request_started")),
        new JProperty("outcome", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("audit-outcome", "pending")),
        new JProperty("status", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("audit-status", 0)),
        new JProperty("userId", jwt == null ? "" : jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", "")),
        new JProperty("user", jwt == null ? "" : jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("preferred_username", "")),
        new JProperty("operation", context.Operation.Id),
        new JProperty("method", context.Request.Method),
        new JProperty("durationMs", context.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds)
      ).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
    }</message>
  </trace>
</fragment>

<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <include-fragment fragment-id="genie-obo-audit" />
    <validate-jwt header-name="Authorization" require-scheme="Bearer" require-expiration-time="true" require-signed-tokens="true" failed-validation-httpcode="401" failed-validation-error-message="A valid delegated Genie token is required." output-token-variable-name="genie-user-jwt">
      <openid-config url="https://login.microsoftonline.com/{{genie-obo-tenant-id}}/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration" />
      <audiences><audience>{{genie-obo-api-client-id}}</audience></audiences>
      <issuers><issuer>https://login.microsoftonline.com/{{genie-obo-tenant-id}}/v2.0</issuer></issuers>
      <required-claims>
        <claim name="tid" match="all"><value>{{genie-obo-tenant-id}}</value></claim>
        <claim name="azp" match="all"><value>{{genie-obo-connector-client-id}}</value></claim>
        <claim name="scp" match="any" separator=" "><value>Genie.Access</value></claim>
      </required-claims>
    </validate-jwt>
    <set-variable name="audit-stage" value="identity_validated" />
    <include-fragment fragment-id="genie-obo-audit" />
    <choose>
      <when condition='@(((Jwt)context.Variables["genie-user-jwt"]).Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", "") != "{{genie-obo-allowed-user-id}}")'>
        <set-variable name="audit-stage" value="request_completed" />
        <set-variable name="audit-outcome" value="failure" />
        <set-variable name="audit-status" value="@(403)" />
        <include-fragment fragment-id="genie-obo-audit" />
        <return-response><set-status code="403" reason="Forbidden" /><set-body>{"error":"User is not authorized for this Genie API."}</set-body></return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <rate-limit-by-key calls="30" renewal-period="60" counter-key='@(((Jwt)context.Variables["genie-user-jwt"]).Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", ""))' />
    <send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="genie-exchange" timeout="20" ignore-error="true">
      <set-url>{{genie-obo-broker-url}}</set-url>
      <set-method>POST</set-method>
      <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="override"><value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value></set-header>
      <set-header name="x-user-assertion" exists-action="override"><value>@(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Authorization", "").Substring(7))</value></set-header>
      <authentication-managed-identity resource="api://{{genie-obo-api-client-id}}" />
    </send-request>
    <set-variable name="audit-stage" value="token_exchange_completed" />
    <set-variable name="audit-status" value='@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<IResponse>("genie-exchange") == null ? 502 : ((IResponse)context.Variables["genie-exchange"]).StatusCode)' />
    <set-variable name="audit-outcome" value='@((int)context.Variables["audit-status"] == 200 ? "success" : "failure")' />
    <include-fragment fragment-id="genie-obo-audit" />
    <choose>
      <when condition='@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<IResponse>("genie-exchange") == null)'>
        <set-variable name="audit-stage" value="request_completed" />
        <include-fragment fragment-id="genie-obo-audit" />
        <return-response><set-status code="502" reason="Token broker unavailable" /><set-body>{"error":"Token broker unavailable."}</set-body></return-response>
      </when>
      <when condition='@(((IResponse)context.Variables["genie-exchange"]).StatusCode != 200)'>
        <set-variable name="audit-stage" value="request_completed" />
        <set-variable name="audit-status" value='@(((IResponse)context.Variables["genie-exchange"]).StatusCode == 401 || ((IResponse)context.Variables["genie-exchange"]).StatusCode == 403 ? 403 : 502)' />
        <include-fragment fragment-id="genie-obo-audit" />
        <return-response><set-status code='@((int)context.Variables["audit-status"])' reason="Token exchange failed" /><set-body>{"error":"User token exchange failed."}</set-body></return-response>
      </when>
    </choose>
    <set-header name="Authorization" exists-action="override"><value>@("Bearer " + (string)((IResponse)context.Variables["genie-exchange"]).Body.As<JObject>()["access_token"])</value></set-header>
    <set-header name="x-user-assertion" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-query-parameter name="subscription-key" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-backend-service base-url="{{databricks-workspace-url}}" />
  </inbound>
  <backend><base /></backend>
  <outbound>
    <base />
    <set-variable name="audit-stage" value="request_completed" />
    <set-variable name="audit-status" value="@(context.Response.StatusCode)" />
    <set-variable name="audit-outcome" value='@(context.Response.StatusCode < 400 ? "success" : "failure")' />
    <include-fragment fragment-id="genie-obo-audit" />
    <set-header name="Cache-Control" exists-action="override"><value>no-store</value></set-header>
    <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="override"><value>@(context.RequestId.ToString())</value></set-header>
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
    <set-variable name="audit-stage" value="request_completed" />
    <set-variable name="audit-outcome" value="failure" />
    <set-variable name="audit-status" value='@(context.LastError.Source == "validate-jwt" ? 401 : (context.LastError.Source == "rate-limit-by-key" ? 429 : 502))' />
    <include-fragment fragment-id="genie-obo-audit" />
    <return-response><set-status code='@((int)context.Variables["audit-status"])' reason="Genie request failed" /><set-body>{"error":"Genie request failed."}</set-body></return-response>
  </on-error>
</policies>

  <inbound>
    <base />
    <rewrite-uri template="/api/2.0/genie/spaces/{{databricks-genie-space-id}}/start-conversation" />
  </inbound>
  <backend><base /></backend>
  <outbound><base /></outbound>
  <on-error><base /></on-error>
</policies>
